name: coss ui (incl. Origin UI)
licence: MIT for apps/ui and apps/origin in github.com/cosscom/coss (rest of the repo AGPL-3.0, per README Licensing section).
bestFor: SaaS product UI (the founder's default stack: Next.js + Tailwind v4 + Base UI)
teams migrating from shadcn/ui who want Base UI primitives
avoidFor: expressive marketing heroes without added art direction (it is deliberately neutral-800 on white)
projects needing a coloured brand primary out of the box (primary is near-black)

families: --font-heading: aliases --font-sans by default (coss.com itself uses Cal Sans 2.0 for both)
typography.notes: Titles use font-heading + font-semibold. Same 16 -> 14px step at sm as Catalyst. Placeholder at muted-foreground/72; icons 18px mobile, 16px desktop, opacity 80%.

color.model: Tailwind oklch palette + --alpha() and color-mix(in srgb) recipes

accents.primary: neutral-800 with neutral-50 text (dark: inverted neutral-100/neutral-800)

color.darkMode: .dark class; surfaces are not separate greys but white mixed 2-5% into neutral-950, borders and fills are white alpha.
color.contrastNotes: Status '-foreground' tokens are a 700 shade used as TEXT on light backgrounds (not text-on-fill), so badges/alerts stay AA. Borders are alpha so they stay visible on any card colour (vendor rationale: 'opaque borders ... crisp, contrasted borders even when backgrounds lack sufficient contrast').

spacing.base: Tailwind 4px; paddings written as calc(--spacing(n) - 1px) to absorb the 1px border so content sits on the 4px grid
spacing.scale: Tailwind default; dialog/card padding 24px (p-6), menu p-1 (4px), menu items h-8/h-7

radius.rule: Controls 8px, containers 16px, inner layers calc(radius - 1px). --radius: 0.625rem is declared but the @theme inline block in the styling docs does not map --radius-* to it, so Tailwind default radii apply (inferred from registry source; verify in a build).

shadows: primary button: shadow-xs tinted primary/24 + inset 0 1px white/16% (top highlight); pressed: inset 0 1px black/8%, outer shadow removed
outline button/input: shadow-xs/5 + before: 0 1px black/4% (bottom lip); dark: before 0 -1px white/6% (top lip)
depth.borders: 1px always present (transparent on ghost/secondary) so all variants share a box; colour is alpha (black 8-10%).

motion.notes: Dialog: 200ms, enter from scale 0.98 + opacity; nested dialogs scale 1 - 0.1 x depth. Tooltip duration-0 (instant on subsequent hovers). Skeleton 2s linear shimmer. Autofill background transition hack 5000000s.

list: + hooks useMediaQuery, useCopyToClipboard; plus 'particles' (pre-assembled patterns) and Cal.com 'atoms'
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: High: hover, focus-visible (ring-2 + offset-1, inputs ring-[3px] ring/24), active/data-pressed, disabled (opacity 64%), loading (data-loading, spinner, text transparent), aria-invalid (border destructive/36, ring destructive/16), autofill, pointer-coarse hit areas, dark variants.

tokenArchitecture: shadcn/ui variable names (background, foreground, primary, muted, accent, border, input, ring, card, popover, sidebar-*) + coss additions (destructive-foreground, info, success, warning with -foreground, code, code-highlight, chart-1..5). Values are recipes (alpha, color-mix) over Tailwind primitives. Fonts via --font-sans/--font-heading/--font-mono.
distinctiveness: Physical micro-depth without gradients: alpha borders + 1px lips (bottom in light, top in dark) + inset highlights on solid buttons; dual density by pointer (touch sizes step down at 640px) and invisible 44px hit areas on coarse pointers.
weaknesses: Neutral-800 primary means every product looks the same until a brand primary is set
Dark mode built from tiny white mixes needs a good display to read
Several docs pages (e.g. migration .md) 404 via the llms.txt path on 2026-10-08
takeaways: Write padding as calc(--spacing(n) - 1px) so bordered controls keep text on the 4px grid.
Use alpha borders and a 1px lip shadow (bottom in light, top in dark) for depth that survives any surface.
Give coarse pointers an invisible 44px ::after hit area instead of bigger visible controls.
provenance: public-spec (registry JSON at coss.com/ui/r/*.json and docs .md files)
apiConventions: render prop for polymorphism (render={<Link/>}), never asChild
menu/select items use onClick, not onSelect
Select items are objects: <Select items={items}> + <SelectItem value={item}>
toasts only via toastManager.add({title, description, data:{status}}) with ToastProvider + AnchoredToastProvider in layout
Dialog = DialogPopup > DialogHeader + DialogPanel + DialogFooter; forms wrap only Panel+Footer in <Form className='contents'>
size prop for sizing, never custom padding classes
ToggleGroup multiple={false}; Slider value is scalar
DialogContent/SheetContent kept as compat aliases of DialogPopup/SheetPopup
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @coss/<name> or init @coss/style
